messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
Hey <@307290318590705667>, we checked into your nation's logs and balance history! Here is what's happening with your iron:

**1. Steel Mill Consumption (~2.89M iron / day)**
Your nation (**Grand Duchy of Bion**) operates **1,800 Steel Mills**. Each steel mill consumes 67 iron/hr (and 38 coal/hr) to manufacture steel:
• 1,800 mills × 67 iron/hr = **120,600 iron/hr**
• Over 24 hours, that is **2,894,400 iron/day** (~2.89M iron/day) continuously consumed to sustain your steel production (feeding your market orders and your 17,000/hr steel trade agreement to Maignalis). Over ~2 days, that accounts for ~5.8M iron.

**2. Why Iron "Reappeared" (Coalition Transfers & Escrow Refunds)**
• **Incoming Ally Transfers:** Your coalition partners have been transferring large batches of iron directly to your nation to keep your 1,800 steel mills supplied:
  - Oct 16: **Centauri Republic** sent you 5,000,000 iron & **Maignalis** sent you 5,000,000 iron
  - Oct 17: **Centauri Republic** sent you 3,000,000 iron
  - Oct 18: **Centauri Republic** sent you 6,000,000 iron
• **Market / Trade Escrow:** When market sell orders or direct trades are posted, the offered iron is held in escrow. If an offer is cancelled, delisted, or expires, that full escrowed amount is refunded directly back into your nation's inventory all at once.

In short, your iron isn't disappearing to a bug—it's being converted into steel by your mills, and the reappearing amounts are incoming bulk transfers from your allies (or trade escrows being released). Everything is working as intended! Let us know if you have any questions!

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
<@307290318590705667> Update on the iron and revenue tracking:

You were completely right that the revenue page was confusing because manufacturing consumption was omitted from the Net breakdown!

**What was happening:**
• Your 1,800 Steel Mills consume **120,600 kg/hr (~2.89M iron/day)** as raw inputs (67 kg iron each per hour).
• Previously, the Revenue page only showed gross mine output and building operating costs (gold), but did *not* fold factory consumption or trade agreement flows into the resource Net cards. That made it appear as though iron was disappearing or numbers didn't reconcile.

**What we just deployed:**
1. **Factory Consumption Tracking:** Manufacturing input consumption (like iron/coal for steel mills, bauxite for aluminium, copper for components) is now calculated and folded directly into Net resource production.
2. **Interactive Revenue Breakdown Tooltips:** On your country overview page, hovering over any resource (or tapping on mobile) now displays a breakdown card showing:
   • Production from mines (+)
   • Factory consumption (-)
   • Active trade agreement flows (+/-)
   • Military upkeep (-)
   • Final Net Hourly & Daily balance
   • Direct subtext tag (e.g. ).

You can now see the exact flow of iron from your mines into your mills without any mystery!

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: Does either the gross or net show exactly how much I make an hour with costs already factored in?

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: Only major thing I want to see on the revenue page is hourly outputs with costs and profits already added  together so I know exactly what I make

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text:
<@307290318590705667> Yes, **Net** is exactly that number!

• **Net:** Shows your **exact hourly gain or loss with all costs, deductions, and inputs factored in**. If Net says +10,000, your inventory increases by 10,000 each hour. If it says -5,000, it decreases by 5,000. It factors in:
  - Mine & building output (+)
  - Factory consumption / raw manufacturing inputs (-) (e.g. the 120.6t iron consumed by your 1,800 steel mills)
  - Active trade agreement flows (+/-)
  - Military maintenance upkeep (-)
  - Building operating costs / upkeep in gold (-)

• **Gross:** Shows only raw baseline extraction *before* any expenses, factory inputs, upkeep, or trade flows are deducted.

So **Net** is always your true hourly bottom line!

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@307290318590705667> And one handy tip: on your country page, you can also toggle between **Hourly** and **Daily (24h)** right above those Net resource cards, so you can see your exact hourly bottom line as well as your full daily net with all profits, inputs, and costs added together! 📊
